parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in the specified region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple database instances. This parameter and the DBInstanceId parameter cannot be both left empty. If both are specified, this parameter takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The namespace.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html operation to query the list
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html接口查看列表
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The password for the namespace.

This value is specified in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

本值为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html接口指定
parameters.name: namespace_password

parameters.help_en:
The name of the collection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401503.html operation to query the list
parameters.help_zh:
集合名。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401503.html接口查看列表
parameters.name: collection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the index creation task, which is obtained from the CreateIndex operation
parameters.help_zh: 创建索引的任务ID，由`CreateIndex`接口获得
parameters.name: job_id

Job.description_en: The details of the index creation task
Job.description_zh: 创建索引的任务的详细信息

Completed.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is completed

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created

Error.description_en: The error message returned when the current operation encounters an exception or fails
Error.description_zh: 当前操作异常或者失败时的错误信息

Progress.description_en:
The creation progress. This value is a percentage, and a value of 100 indicates that the task is completed.

Only AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL 7.0 instances support progress updates
Progress.description_zh:
创建进度，此数值为进度百分比，值为 100 时表示完成。

仅 AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0 版实例支持进度更新

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
Success: Successful.
Failed: Failed. You can check the Error field for the cause of the failure.
Cancelled: Canceled.
Running: Running
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值说明：
Success：成功。
Failed：失败，失败原因可查看 Error 字段。
Cancelled：已取消。
Running：执行中

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the task was updated

Message.description_en: The detailed information returned by the API operation

Status.description_en:
The execution status of the API operation. Valid values:
success: Successful.
fail: Failed
Status.description_zh:
API执行状态，取值如下：
success：执行成功。
fail：执行失败
